project: Italian Rice Restaurant — The Adaptive Reuse of an Italian Cascina
note: Boards b02–b04 cropped to ten images, WebP q88 (PIL), max 2000 px wide; composites are laid out on the boards' own paper colour. The portfolio cover b01 (student's name, cover photo) is not used at all; excluded by cropping or flat paper-colour fills: the title block with the board number, the round-inset site map, the Problem site photos, the Design idea collage (people, food, stock photos), the Vialone Nano rice photo and the Local dish food photos on b02; the photo of hands holding the roof model and the 'Using a knife' photo on b03; the material texture swatches and the two food photos in Shape generation on b04. No retouching.
